abstract: This study develops an open economy version of the health deficit model to examine how rising health expenditures affect international capital flows, external balances, and welfare. The government issues bonds in international capital markets, linking health policy to international financial dynamics. Calibrated to the UK, the model evaluates income growth, medical innovation, and population aging shocks under balanced budget and deficit spending regimes. Results show that the source of health spending growth determines the direction of capital flows, and that deficit-financed health spending generally yields higher welfare by enabling additional health investment without higher domestic taxation.
abstract_zh: 本研究构建了健康赤字模型的开放经济版本，以考察健康支出上升如何影响国际资本流动、外部平衡及福利。政府在国际资本市场上发行债券，将健康政策与国际金融动态联系起来。以英国为校准对象，该模型在平衡预算和赤字支出制度下评估了收入增长、医疗创新及人口老龄化冲击。结果表明，健康支出增长的来源决定了资本流动的方向，且赤字融资的健康支出通常能带来更高福利，因为这使得在不增加国内税收的情况下实现额外健康投资成为可能。
title: The role of foreign capital flows in health finance
title_zh: 外国资本流动在卫生融资中的作用

abstract: • Literature on EU agri-food policies show limited and often uneven impacts across dimensions. • Policy effectiveness is highly heterogeneous across Member States and regions. • Compliance, governance, and targeting emerge as key recurring policy challenges. • Lack of outcome-based indicators and data limits evaluation of policy impacts. • Stronger governance is needed to align EU agri-food policies with sustainability. The European Union’s agri-food policies aim to balance productivity with environmental, social, and economic sustainability. However, their overall effectiveness remains debated due to fragmented evidence and inconsistent implementation. This study critically reviews the literature on the cumulative impacts of EU policies governing primary agricultural production, focusing on six sectors: the Common Agricultural Policy, genetically modified organisms, pesticide, fertilizers, fisheries, and animal health and welfare. Using a two-step approach, we first mapped EU-level policies, retaining 38 policies that met predefined criteria (binding EU scope, production-related, impact-oriented, and active since 2000). We then conducted a qualitative synthesis of 97 peer-reviewed studies (from 1.359 retrieved), coding the environmental, social, and economic impacts reported in these studies. Results reveal three systemic weaknesses limiting policy effectiveness across sectors: i) compliance gaps, where high implementation costs and limited enforcement create uneven outcomes across actors and Member States; ii) governance tensions, driven by subsidiarity ambiguities and fragmented decision-making; and iii) targeting deficiencies, where vague objectives reduce effectiveness and accountability. Environmentally, region-specific agri-environmental measures show localized benefits but fail to address systemic pressures like persistent nitrate pollution and delays in pesticide reassessments. Socially, advances in food safety and animal welfare coexist with exclusionary effects, notably the marginalization of small-scale fishers. Economically, compliance costs disproportionately burden smaller operators, while larger actors tend to leverage regulatory complexity and loopholes to their advantages. To overcome these structural challenges, the EU must set clearer objectives aligned with long-term sustainability goals, streamline decision-making responsibilities across governance levels, and implement robust outcome-based monitoring to ensure adaptability and accountability.
abstract_zh: 欧盟农食政策相关文献显示，其影响在各维度上有限且往往不均衡。政策有效性在成员国和地区之间高度异质。合规性、治理和目标定位成为反复出现的核心政策挑战。缺乏基于结果的指标和数据限制了政策影响的评估。需要更强有力的治理来使欧盟农食政策与可持续性目标保持一致。欧盟的农食政策旨在平衡生产力与环境、社会和经济可持续性。然而，由于证据碎片化和执行不一致，其整体有效性仍存争议。本研究对关于欧盟初级农业生产政策累积影响的文献进行了批判性综述，聚焦六个领域：共同农业政策、转基因生物、农药、化肥、渔业以及动物健康与福利。采用两步法，我们首先梳理了欧盟层面的政策，保留了38项符合预设标准（具有约束力的欧盟范围、与生产相关、以影响为导向且自2000年起生效）的政策。随后，我们对97篇同行评审研究（从1，359篇检索文献中筛选）进行了定性综合，并对这些研究报告的环境、社会和经济影响进行了编码。结果揭示了跨部门限制政策有效性的三个系统性弱点：i) 合规缺口，高执行成本和有限执法导致不同行为体和成员国之间结果不均衡；ii) 治理张力，源于辅助性原则模糊性和碎片化决策；iii) 目标定位缺陷，模糊目标降低了有效性和问责性。在环境方面，区域特定的农业环境措施显示出局部效益，但未能解决系统性压力，如持续的硝酸盐污染和农药再评估延迟。在社会方面，食品安全和动物福利的进步与排斥效应并存，尤其是小规模渔民被边缘化。在经济方面，合规成本不成比例地加重了小规模经营者的负担，而较大规模行为体则倾向于利用监管复杂性和漏洞获取优势。为克服这些结构性挑战，欧盟必须设定与长期可持续目标相一致的更清晰目标，理顺各治理层面的决策责任，并实施强有力的基于结果的监测，以确保适应性和问责性。
title: A critical review of EU agri-food policy impacts
title_zh: 欧盟农业食品政策影响的关键评述

abstract: ABSTRACT Exploiting the heteroskedasticity of the changes in short‐term and long‐term interest rates and exchange rates around the FOMC announcement, we identify three structural monetary policy shocks. We eliminate the predictable part of the shocks and study their effects on financial variables and macro variables. The first shock resembles a conventional monetary policy shock, and the second resembles an unconventional monetary shock. The third shock leads to an increase in interest rates, stock prices, industrial production, consumer prices, and commodity prices. At the same time, the excess bond premium and uncertainty decrease, and the U.S. dollar depreciates. Therefore, this third shock combines all the characteristics of a central bank information shock.
journal: Oxford Bulletin of Economics and Statistics
title: Is There an Information Channel of Monetary Policy?
title_zh: 货币政策是否存在信息渠道？

abstract: OLS estimates of linear regression models become imprecise when distributional assumptions about the regression errors are not strictly met. Such situations frequently arise in applied research due to the heavy-tailed distributions of dependent variables. Using simulated data and replication settings, we show how robust regression estimation can produce more policy-relevant inferences by increasing the precision of estimates, improving test power, and tightening confidence intervals. We provide guidance to researchers on when and how to apply robust estimation as alternative to OLS and how to combine robust regression estimators with fixed effects and clustered standard errors. Given the non-random nature of observations typically downweighted by robust regression estimators, we also illustrate the importance of inspecting the robust regression weights and discuss how these weights can provide useful insights about heterogeneity in treatment effects or relations of interest.
abstract_zh: 当回归误差的分布假设未得到严格满足时，线性回归模型的OLS估计会变得不精确。这种情况在应用研究中经常出现，原因在于因变量具有重尾分布。利用模拟数据和复制设定，我们展示了稳健回归估计如何通过提高估计精度、增强检验功效以及收紧置信区间，从而产生更具政策相关性的推断。我们为研究者提供指导，说明何时以及如何将稳健估计作为OLS的替代方法应用，以及如何将稳健回归估计器与固定效应和聚类标准误相结合。鉴于稳健回归估计器通常降权的观测具有非随机性质，我们还阐述了检查稳健回归权重的重要性，并讨论了这些权重如何为处理效应或感兴趣关系的异质性提供有用见解。
source_issue: Journal of Accounting and Economics, Volume 82, Issue 1
title: Estimation precision and robust inference in archival research
title_zh: 档案研究中的估计精度与稳健推断

abstract: This study examines how exposure to armed conflict affects group-specific trust, focusing on individuals exposed during military service. Our identification strategy exploits a population-level natural experiment generated by Turkey’s strict military conscription system and its long-running civil conflict. We combine this setting with an original field survey to identify causal effects and examine individual-level mechanisms while minimizing contextual confounding. We find that men exposed to the armed conflict during their conscription service exhibit elevated ingroup trust, with no corresponding increase in trust toward outgroups or in generalized trust. In contrast, those with battlefield traumas display lower trust overall. Exposed veterans also display stronger ingroup-biased attitudes like nationalism, intolerance, religiosity, and adherence to social norms. These results suggest that conflict exposure shifts social preferences toward ingroup favouritism without strengthening broader forms of trust, a pattern that is likely to hinder the accumulation of social capital and, in turn, adversely affect long-run economic development and institutional quality. abstract_zh: 本研究探讨武装冲突经历如何影响群体特定信任，重点关注服役期间暴露于冲突的个体。我们的识别策略利用土耳其严格兵役制度及其长期内战冲突所产生的人口层面自然实验。通过结合这一情境与原创实地调查，我们在最小化情境混杂因素的同时识别因果效应并考察个体层面机制。研究发现，在服役期间暴露于武装冲突的男性表现出更强的内群体信任，但对外群体信任或普遍信任并未相应提升。相反，经历战场创伤的个体整体信任水平较低。暴露于冲突的退伍军人还表现出更强的内群体偏好倾向，如民族主义、不宽容、宗教虔诚及对社会规范的遵从。这些结果表明，冲突经历将社会偏好转向内群体偏袒，却未能强化更广泛的信任形式，这种模式可能阻碍社会资本积累，进而对长期经济发展和制度质量产生不利影响。
title: Armed conflict exposure and trust: evidence from a natural experiment*
title_zh: 武装冲突暴露与信任：来自自然实验的证据

abstract: This paper develops a dynamic political-economy model of trade-policy hysteresis. Tariffs reduce innovation and competitiveness but generate short-run benefits for import-competing sectors, creating incentives for myopic policymakers to adopt protectionism. The interaction between myopic protectionist policy and slow-moving competitiveness generates two stable steady states: a low-tariff, high-competitiveness regime and a high-tariff, low-competitiveness regime. Although free trade is welfare superior, it is politically fragile. Temporary tariff shocks that sufficiently erode competitiveness can permanently shift political incentives toward protectionism, trapping the economy in a low-competitiveness equilibrium with persistently high tariffs and lower welfare.
abstract_zh: 本文构建了一个关于贸易政策滞后性的动态政治经济学模型。关税降低了创新与竞争力，却为进口竞争部门带来短期利益，从而激励短视的政策制定者采取保护主义。短视的保护主义政策与缓慢变动的竞争力之间的相互作用，产生了两个稳定的稳态：一个低关税、高竞争力的体制，以及一个高关税、低竞争力的体制。尽管自由贸易在福利上更优，但在政治上却显得脆弱。暂时性的关税冲击若足以侵蚀竞争力，便能永久性地将政治激励转向保护主义，使经济陷入低竞争力均衡，伴随持续高关税与更低福利。
title: Tipping into protectionism: Tariff shocks and the fragility of free trade
title_zh: 转向保护主义：关税冲击与自由贸易的脆弱性

abstract: The determination of firm- and industry-level market power is studied in a model with search frictions driven by matching and incomplete information and in which heterogeneous firms compete for sales to ex ante homogeneous buyers. Combining directed search and random meetings sequentially, market tightness and the distributions of prices and productivity across active firms are determined jointly in equilibrium. We relate firm-level variation in prices and markups to variation in the elasticity of demand at the firm level. These distributions respond endogenously to changes in variable costs, utility from consumption, fixed costs of both entry and operation, and the consumer search process. We refer to these responses as pass-through and characterize them for both individual firms and the industry average. We show further that owing to the equilibrium determination of market tightness and the price distribution in directed search, improvements in consumer welfare may be associated with either increases or decreases in average markups.
abstract_zh: 本文在一个由匹配和不完全信息驱动的搜索摩擦模型中，研究了企业层面和行业层面的市场势力决定问题，其中异质性企业竞争向事前同质的买家销售产品。通过将定向搜索与随机相遇顺序结合，市场紧度以及活跃企业间的价格和生产率分布在内生均衡中共同决定。我们将企业层面的价格和加成率变动与企业层面需求弹性的变动联系起来。这些分布会对可变成本、消费效用、进入和运营的固定成本以及消费者搜索过程的变化作出内生反应。我们将这些反应称为传导效应，并分别刻画单个企业和行业平均水平的传导特征。我们进一步表明，由于定向搜索中市场紧度和价格分布的均衡决定，消费者福利的改善可能与平均加成率的上升或下降相关联。
title: Markups, pass-through, and firm heterogeneity with sequentially mixed search
title_zh: 顺序混合搜索中的加成、传导与企业异质性

abstract: This paper studies occupational mobility over the business cycle. We divide occupations into two broad groups, "attractive" and "nonattractive," where we label an occupation attractive if the total net inflow into this occupation through job-to-job transition is positive or its median annual wage is above the median of the population. We measure total net inflows into both occupation groups. We measure these inflows separately for job-to-job (EE) transitions and transitions from unemployment to employment (UE). We find net inflow from nonattractive to attractive occupations through EE transitions slows during recessions. The relative net inflow through UE transitions has a similar cyclicality. This finding suggests a novel cost of recession: during recessions, workers have fewer opportunities to move to a better occupation.
abstract_zh: 本文研究了商业周期中的职业流动性。我们将职业划分为两大类：“吸引力强”与“吸引力弱”，其中，若某职业通过工作间转换实现的总净流入为正，或其年薪中位数高于总体中位数，则将其标记为吸引力强。我们分别衡量了这两类职业群体的总净流入，并针对工作间转换（EE）及从失业到就业（UE）的转换分别测算了这些流入量。研究发现，在经济衰退期间，通过EE转换从吸引力弱职业流向吸引力强职业的净流入减缓。UE转换的相对净流入也呈现出类似的周期性变化。这一发现揭示了衰退的新成本：在经济衰退期间，工人转向更优职业的机会减少。
title: Occupation ladders over the business cycle
title_zh: 经济周期中的职业阶梯

abstract: This paper studies the optimal design of corrective subsidies when eligibility and subsidy levels can be differentiated across observable recipient categories, such as geographic location or housing type. Although such categorical targeting is common in practice, there is limited normative guidance on how to design it when externality correction, cost-effectiveness, and redistribution must be balanced under a budget constraint. We develop a framework that decomposes the optimal subsidy for each category into three components reflecting these objectives. We show how the optimal design depends systematically on category-specific primitives—positive externalities, subsidy responsiveness, and the average social welfare weight of subsidy recipients—and on the program budget. We apply the framework to residential solar PV installation subsidy programs in Japan, some of which differentiate support between new and existing homes. We provide causal evidence that existing homes are 2 to 3.5 times more responsive to subsidies than new homes. Our simulations show that, in most scenarios, this large difference makes it optimal to assign higher subsidies to existing homes, generating sizable welfare gains relative to a uniform design (15% in the benchmark case). More generally, our theoretical and empirical results highlight the importance of systematically incorporating these factors into the design of categorically targeted corrective subsidies.
abstract_zh: 本文研究了当资格条件和补贴水平可根据可观察的受助类别（如地理位置或住房类型）进行差异化设定时，矫正性补贴的最优设计问题。尽管此类分类定向在实践中较为常见，但在预算约束下需兼顾外部性矫正、成本效益与再分配目标时，关于如何设计此类补贴的规范性指导却相对有限。我们构建了一个分析框架，将每一类别的最优补贴分解为反映上述三个目标的组成部分。我们展示了最优设计如何系统性地依赖于类别特定的基础要素——正外部性、补贴响应度以及补贴受助者的平均社会福利权重——以及项目预算。我们将该框架应用于日本住宅太阳能光伏安装补贴项目，其中部分项目对新旧住宅的扶持力度有所区分。我们提供了因果证据，表明现有住宅对补贴的响应度是新住宅的2至3.5倍。模拟结果显示，在大多数情境下，这一显著差异使得向现有住宅提供更高补贴成为最优选择，相较于统一设计可产生可观的福利收益（基准情形下为15%）。更广泛而言，我们的理论与实证结果强调了在分类定向矫正性补贴设计中系统纳入这些因素的重要性。
journal: Journal of Environmental Economics and Management
source_issue: Journal of Environmental Economics and Management, Volume 139
title: Cost-effective and equitable targeting of corrective subsidies: Differentiated green subsidies for new and existing homes
title_zh: 成本效益与公平导向的矫正性补贴：新旧住宅差异化绿色补贴
